breakdown.description: Engineering stress is defined with the original area A_0, not the final area A_f.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly defined engineering stress using the final area (A_f). The ground truth corrects this by defining it with the original area (A_0). The agent's generated output explicitly repeated the user's error by stating, 'The engineering stress is calculated as load divided by final cross-sectional area.'
